title_en: Active-Duty Soldier Recruitment Schedule for All Armed Forces Branches (November 2026)
summary: Persons liable for military service who wish to serve in a military specialty related to their major, qualifications, licences or experience may apply through the Military Manpower Administration's active-duty soldier recruitment system. This notice covers applications made in November 2026 for enlistment scheduled for February 2027. The detailed recruitment schedule for each branch is in the attached file, which was not read for this translation.
applies_to: Persons liable for military service (병역의무자) who wish to apply for active-duty soldier recruitment in a military specialty related to their major, qualifications, licences or experience, applying in November 2026 for enlistment in February 2027. The notice is informational and does not state that any action is mandatory.

dates.what: Application period for active-duty soldier recruitment in all armed forces branches
dates.when: November 2026 (exact dates are in the attachment, which was not read)

dates.what: Scheduled enlistment for those who apply in November 2026

conditions: The detailed schedule for each branch is given only in the attached file, which was not read for this translation.
steps: Download and read the attached file "'26년 11월 각 군 현역병 모집계획(배부용).hwp" for the recruitment schedule of each armed forces branch.
If you wish to apply, apply in November 2026 according to the schedule in the attachment.
translation:
Title: Active-Duty Soldier Recruitment Schedule for All Armed Forces Branches (November 2026)

The Military Manpower Administration operates an active-duty soldier recruitment system that allows persons liable for military service to apply for a military specialty related to their major, qualifications, licences or experience, and to serve in that field.

The recruitment schedule for active-duty soldiers in each armed forces branch, for those applying in November 2026 with enlistment scheduled for February 2027, is sent as attached.

Attachment (1 file): '26년 11월 각 군 현역병 모집계획(배부용).hwp [November 2026 Active-Duty Soldier Recruitment Plan for All Branches (for distribution)] (1 MB). The content of this attachment was not read for this translation.
